titulo_resena: If you’re not sweating a lot, this cover is great. If you are - not so much
texto:
If you’re using it just for a watch or walks/runs, it’s GREAT! If not, read on.

I loved this cover - until my first really intense workout. When I was just running and not sweating much, it was GREAT! But once I did my outdoor HIIT workout, sweat got underneath the cover and the touchscreen wouldn’t work. I had to completely remove the cover (which involves taking off the bands) to stop my workout. Once this happened after three different workouts, I took it off. My son had the same issue after the workouts.
Easy to install. The screen protector is too small compared to the front of the iPhone. A lot of the white part of the front of the phone is exposed.
